title: The owner answers through an agent and can reverse the relay on the dashboard
description: A real CLI and control plane park a goals-and-priorities request, refuse an agent answer without --owner-said, record Not yet with --decline, and remove it from Needs you. The same CLI relays a human-proof answer. The signed-in owner sees both attributed quotes and reverses each from the dashboard; history preserves both answers. Fails on the base tip because --owner-said is refused.

steps.name: Relay owner decisions and reverse them in the dashboard
